ClearanceDateText: CLEARANCE DATE: The applicant must complete the badging process within 30 days of receiving a clearance date. Failure to complete the badging process within 30 days, to include security training & issuance, will require the applicant to be fingerprinted again before a badge can be issued. Should the 30-days period expire, an additional charge may be applicable for processing as additional security check.
AdvisoryText: After verifying the correct badge number was submitted, you must deny access and immediately notify OPD Police Dispatch at 909-986-3371 or by dialing 911. Do not advise the individual of the badge verification result.
